kilde: International Journal of Social and Psychological Aspects of Healthcare
sammendrag: The present trial evaluated whether a supported employment approach based on the Individual Placement and Support (IPS) framework produces advantages in psychological well-being, everyday functioning, and labor-market participation for adults with severe mental disorders (SMD) living in an environment marked by widespread unemployment, relative to conventional vocational rehabilitation (VR). tittel: A Randomized Controlled Investigation of Individual Placement and Support for Severe Mental Disorders, Examining Psychological Well-Being, Daily Functioning, and Employment Outcomes Within a High-Unemployment Environment
